strategy_1_pure_pennation_isomass.description: Pure structural remodeling of pennation angle (14 to 18 deg) at strictly constant muscle volume.
strategy_1_pure_pennation_isomass.verdict: UNBALANCED: +25.2% isometric strength is achieved, but peak power drops (-2.0%), velocity drops (-21.7%), and daily tendon fatigue damage accelerates by 6.2x.

strategy_2_coordinated_biological_enhanc.description: Multi-factorial biological adaptation: +2 deg pennation, +8% specific tension (Type II shift), +12% intrinsic cross-bridge speed, +15% tendon CSA, +8% tendon UTS.
strategy_2_coordinated_biological_enhanc.verdict: SYNERGISTIC_OPTIMUM: +20.4% torque gain achieved with velocity preserved (-1.7%), peak power elevated (+18.2%), and tendon fatigue durability preserved (0.97x baseline damage ratio).

pareto_optimization_summary.feasibility_verdict: 102 of 1000 sampled parameter configurations simultaneously achieve >= +20% torque gain, static SF >= 1.50, and fatigue retention >= 0.80x baseline. All viable configurations require coordinated muscle and tendon adaptations: pure muscle adaptations without tendon hypertrophy fail mechanical safety gates.
